title: Ledger and Letter
author: N. M. Voss
blurb: Ansel Pemberton, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
